verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers self-hosting with 'full data ownership' (Community/Enterprise Edition), which indirectly gives operators control over where and how long data is retained, but there is no explicit documentation of data retention policies, deletion controls, or data lifecycle management for AI-native workflows or MCP/AI feature data. Missing for 10: explicit retention/deletion settings or APIs, documentation on how long request/collection/AI data is stored, and confirmation that AI-feature data (docs-23/35) or MCP-server data (docs-32) can be deleted or is not retained.
